What do beginners usually say about it in reviews?
In independent reviews and customer feedback, first-time owners frequently highlight:
Modularity and flexibility: Customers love being able to easily move, reconfigure, or expand their sofa over time, or replace individual components instead of buying a whole new couch.
Easy assembly: Assembly is straightforward for most setups, taking about 5 to 10 minutes per seat.
Everyday practicality: Features like removable, machine-washable covers, compact box delivery (fitting easily through standard doorways and hallways), and built-in storage or sleeper options are often praised.
Comfort options: Reviewers appreciate having distinct comfort choices, ranging from the cloud-like, plush feel of Ciello or Gaia to the balanced, medium-firm support of Atmosphere.
On the critical side, some customers have noted:
Assembly challenges: Depending on the collection, some people have found connecting certain modules or putting on tight-fitting covers trickier than expected.
Delivery timing: Because sofas ship in multiple boxes (typically 4 to 5), packages sometimes arrive on different days, and carrier tracking visibility can vary.
Cushion maintenance: Softer, loose foam-and-fiber cushions (like those on Ciello and Gaia) require regular fluffing every 1 to 2 weeks to keep their shape and support.

Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
To get started, you don't need any special tools or equipment—our sofas assemble without tools, and hardware is included right in the packaging (often packed inside the seat bases or zippered compartments).
Here are a few practical tips to keep in mind:
Measure your space: Make sure to measure the full width and depth of the area where you want the sofa to go, including doorways and hallways (boxes average around 30 inches in length, width, and height). You can use our online sofa configurator on the website to see dimensions update in real time as you adjust configurations.
Assembly instructions: Step-by-step PDF instructions are available on our Assembly Guides page, and you can also watch video walkthroughs on our YouTube page.
Free expert guidance: If you want personalized advice on selecting the right layout or fabric for your room, you can always book a free online Design Consultation.

What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?
All Cozey items come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them. If it isn't the right fit for your space, you can return it completely free of charge, as long as it is sent back in its original packaging.
A few key details to keep in mind:
Original boxes: Be sure to keep all original packaging. If any boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) will be deducted from your refund.
Starting a return: You can initiate a return anytime through our Self-Service Portal.
Inspection and refund: Once we receive the returned items, our Quality Assurance Team will inspect them to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications. After inspection, please allow 3 to 7 business days for your refund to be processed.
